title: Uniform influence and sharp thresholds for graph and hypergraph properties

result.label: Uniform influence and sharp thresholds for graph and hypergraph properties
result.statement: Proves the Friedgut–Kalai threshold-width conjectures for graphs and fixed-uniformity hypergraphs. For fixed 0 1/2, every nontrivial increasing relabeling-invariant property crosses from probability ε to 1- within width O(( n)^ -2 ) for graphs and Or(( n)^ -r/(r-1) ) for r -uniform hypergraphs, r ≥ 3. The hypergraph influence bound also applies to nonmonotone properties.
